freelancer-vs-web-design-agency-when-to-: An agency proposal may offer several named contributors and documented cover, but verify that arrangement in the actual contract. Ask who performs design, development and search work, who can cover an absence, and how the business retrieves its material. A qualified solo developer may also provide an appropriate continuity plan; an agency label does not establish one.

website-security-basics-small-business: Use the relevant provider's current guidance to configure HTTPS, account access and supported multi-factor authentication. A recent, usable backup can help recover after an accidental deletion, failed update or compromise, but recovery time depends on its coverage, integrity and the application's dependencies. Test restoration in an appropriate isolated environment and establish what new records would be lost before replacing production data.
